description: Implementation of the Bbr2StartupMode class for congestion control in QUIC, including startup phase logic, bandwidth management, and congestion event handling.

classes.name: Bbr2StartupMode
classes.description: Implements the startup phase of BBRv2 congestion control, managing bandwidth estimation, congestion events, and transition logic.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode
methods.description: Constructor initializing startup mode, updating connection stats and setting pacing and cwnd gains.

methods.name: Enter
methods.description: Should not be called; logs a bug if invoked.

methods.name: Leave
methods.description: Stops the slowstart duration timer and clears bandwidth lower bound.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events during startup, checks for bandwidth growth, loss conditions, and adjusts pacing gain.

methods.name: CheckExcessiveLosses
methods.description: Checks for excessive packet loss to exit startup phase.

methods.name: ExportDebugState
methods.description: Exports internal debug state for diagnostics.
